title: Clarification request
description: PERD REQ-AMB-004. A CLARIFY decision carries this object. Labels are produced from pack templates by core, never by a model, and hold only user-verifiable details (amount, local time, last four digits, a masked display name). No label has more than four consecutive digits. Whether labels can distinguish the options is checked by core (identical displayed details mean ESCALATE). Added by DEC-2026-10-20 D4: an optional mode field, and an attribute field that ATTRIBUTE mode requires. Existing fields are unchanged. Added in place by A275 (before any consumer): none_option_id, required, so an earlier document without it no longer validates.

none_option_id.description: A275: the ID of the 'None of these' choice, minted by core, unique per clarification and never equal to an option_id of the same clarification (not expressible in JSON Schema; tools/contracts/validate.py checks it). The UI submits it as option_id (PERD section 39.2) and never invents a sentinel.

round.description: 1-based. At most 2 rounds per slot (DEC-2026-10-17), then ESCALATE.

mode.description: DEC-2026-10-20 D4. OPTIONS (the default when absent) lists the candidates; ATTRIBUTE asks by the one attribute whose values uniquely partition the candidate set, and names it. Chosen by core deterministically (maximum expected information gain, ties broken by the pack's fixed attribute order); never by a model. A582 (interim): SLOT asks the customer for the value of one slot when there is nothing to choose from (no candidate set was read): candidate_set_id and candidate_set_version are not required, options is empty, and the question is a pack template named by question_key, in plain language; the answer is ordinary untrusted text through the normal intake and schema gate (A591). In SLOT mode there is nothing to choose, so allow_none and none_option_id are not allowed either (A593): no card shows a 'None of these'. Every other mode requires candidate_set_id, candidate_set_version, options, allow_none and none_option_id (A600).

attribute.description: ATTRIBUTE mode only: the candidate attribute asked about. The option values are the options[] labels, each produced by core from the candidate's value for this attribute.
